audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 and Level 6 were given to Ziggs, Level 2 read Skill, and 2+ items read Heimerdinger — the mirror settled all four differently.
audit.why: The mirror (heimerdinger__ziggs) flipped rows 0, 1, 4 and 6 to Skill, Heimerdinger, Skill and Ziggs as one atomic group. Level 1 is not free for you once Micro-Rockets out-range your bomb, and 2+ items is yours because a 5000-range ultimate beats a static turret line.
audit.corrected: The same four rows flipped on both layers here, ratings adjusted to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flagged that the matchup never names a single Heimerdinger ability, and no cooldowns appeared anywhere.
audit.why: H-28 G Evolution Turret is a 1s cooldown at 350 range for 20 mana — he rebuilds the nest faster than you break it. Hextech Micro-Rockets 11/10/9/8/7s at 1325. CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade a flat 11s at 970, stunning only on a direct hit and slowing around it. UPGRADE!!! 100/85/70s. Your Satchel Charge reaches 1000 and Hexplosive Minefield 900, so both can break the turret line from outside it.
audit.corrected: Real names and cooldowns written into early, mid, spikes[0], spikes[3] and the phase whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page called his rockets 'Q rockets' in four fields, claimed your Bouncing Bomb out-ranges them, and invented an ability called 'CH-3X Lightning Grenade'.
audit.why: The rockets are Hextech Micro-Rockets and they are his W, at 1325 range against Bouncing Bomb's 850 — he out-ranges you by 475 units, the opposite of what the page said, and every 'step up when his Q is down' line was pointing at the wrong button. His Q is the turret. 'CH-3X Lightning Grenade' does not exist in the kit; the grenade is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, and UPGRADE!!! simply empowers his next spell.
audit.corrected: Correct slots and names throughout, the real range relationship, and the invented ability removed.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 you edge it: before Heimer has a turret nest your Bouncing Bomb out-ranges his Q rockets and you can shove, but respect that his first turret gives him wave control the moment it's placed.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are close: Micro-Rockets (W) reach 1325 to your 850, so he out-ranges you — aim decides this, not reach. His H-28 G Evolution Turret (Q) is 1s and 20 mana, and it owns the wave the moment it lands.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 are a true poke mirror and a skill matchup: whoever lands their skillshots and manages the turret line wins the trade, so W Satchel his turrets, E the approach, and only step up when his Q is down. Level 6 tilts your way as R breaks his whole nest at once.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 are a poke mirror decided by aim and by the turret line: Satchel his turrets, mine the approach, and step up only while Micro-Rockets (W) is down — 11s at rank 1, same as the CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (E) that stuns on a direct hit at 970.

edits.before: This is a poke mirror: Heimer's H-28 turrets zone the wave but you can W Satchel Charge them from a screen away and E Hexplosive Minefield the approach, so target the turrets and trade only when his Q rockets are on cooldown.
edits.after: A poke mirror: H-28 G Evolution Turret (Q) zones the wave, but Satchel Charge reaches 1000 and Hexplosive Minefield 900, so you can break the line without walking in. Trade while Micro-Rockets (W) is down — his W, not his Q, and 11s.

edits.before: Grouped, Heimer's turret walls and CH-3X Lightning Grenade zone chokes better than you can, and his RQ upgraded rockets out-poke your Bouncing Bomb; play flanks and hit him from angles his turrets don't cover.
edits.after: Grouped, his turret line and CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (E) hold a choke better than you can, and UPGRADE!!! (R) empowers whichever spell he casts next — 100s at rank 1. Play flanks and angles his turrets do not cover.

edits.before: Trade only when his Q rockets are on cooldown
edits.after: Trade only while Micro-Rockets (W) is down

edits.before: Out-siege you with upgraded RQ rockets and turret DPS
edits.after: Out-siege you with an UPGRADE!!! spell and turret DPS

notes: 'CH-3X Lightning Grenade' was a fabricated ability name in spikes[3]; the grenade is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade. The rockets were mislabelled as his Q in four fields, which also made every 'step up when his Q is down' instruction point at a 1-second cooldown instead of an 11-second one. Not asserted: whether Satchel Charge's knockback moves or destroys a deployed turret, and whether Hexplosive Minefield mines detonate on turrets — neither is in Riot's text, and both would change the turret-clearing advice materially if true.
